The name is derived from the Arabic root s-r-', which carries the meaning of 'exaltedness' or 'nobility'. This spiritual significance resonates with the Islamic belief in the greatness and compassion of Allah. It serves as a reminder that as believers, we strive to live our lives in a manner that is pleasing to Allah and reflect the noble qualities of His creation. The name "Sarae" also evokes the idea of elevation in the spiritual journey, inspiring the individual to continually seek knowledge, wisdom, and closeness to Allah. Overall, the name "Sarae" is a spiritual badge of honor, a reminder of our connection to the Divine and the noble journey we embark upon as Muslims.
